<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that duplicate claims from the same incident (phone vs. web portal) go undetected, causing confusion in reserves, reporting, and supplier coordination. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap pages: 'Reporting navigation' (both the Notion page and unstarted Shortcut story 4137), 'Claim search refinements' (4128, completed 2026-09-15), 'Workspace administration' (4131, completed), and 'Supplier contact details' (4129, completed). None of these address duplicate claim detection or alerting; they cover navigation, filtering, admin settings, and supplier contacts, and all similarity scores are very low (≤0.081). No shipped story or roadmap item solves the duplicate-detection problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
